name: AirPods Pro 3
summary: Apple’s 2025 in-ear AirPods Pro: stronger noise cancelling, a heart-rate sensor for workouts, hearing-health features and IP57.
highlights: Up to 8 h with noise cancelling

audio.anc: Yes (Active Noise Cancellation, Adaptive Audio, Transparency)
audio.spatial: Personalised Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking
audio.mics: Dual beamforming microphones and an inward-facing microphone
audio.features: Hearing Test, Hearing Aid, Hearing Protection, Live Translation, Conversation Awareness

battery.claim: Up to 8 h per charge and 24 h with the case, noise cancelling on; 6.5 h with heart-rate sensing

connectivity.compatibility: Made for iPhone, iPad and Mac; with other devices they work as Bluetooth earbuds with fewer features

software.features: Heart-rate sensor for workouts; Find My with speaker and Ultra Wideband in the case

default.note: Read from Apple Malaysia’s tech-specs page. Battery figures are Apple’s own claims.
